AutoSpace 0.5.0-beta.14 is the fourteenth public beta — a prerelease, on the beta line.

## New features
- Dashboard, reworked after its first outing: legends glow steel blue now — amber is kept for the ring-glow, highlights, and selected marks — with gauge ticks on sliders and progress bars, silver trim dividers between sections, and a two-level light mode (dark grey field, near-black buttons). Pick it in Settings, under Pairs.

## Improvements
- No improvements in this release.

## Bug fixes
- No bug fixes in this release.

## Maintenance
- No maintenance changes in this release.
